description.zh: 把一堆东西平均分，分到每人再也分不到一份时停下，剩下的就是余数，所以余数一定比除数小；“被除数 = 除数 × 商 + 余数”是这本账，星期几的循环也只看余数。
description.en: Share things out equally until there is not enough left to give everyone one more, and what remains is the remainder — so it is always smaller than the divisor; “dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder” is the ledger, and cycles like the days of the week depend only on the remainder.

aliases.en: why is the remainder smaller than the divisor
what weekday is it 100 days from now

label.zh: 辗转相除就是一连串带余除法
label.en: Euclid’s algorithm is a chain of divisions with remainder

reason.zh: 求最大公因数时，用大数除以小数取余数，再用除数除以余数……每一步都是一次带余除法；余数一次比一次小，所以链条一定会结束。
reason.en: To find a greatest common divisor, divide the larger number by the smaller and keep the remainder, then divide the divisor by that remainder, and so on — each step is a division with remainder; the remainders keep shrinking, so the chain must end.
